product.title: Limbajul secret al succesului. Cum să înțelegi și să folosești comunicarea non-verbală
product.description: Știai că oamenii cărora li te adresezi ți-au evaluat deja subliminal, în primele șapte secunde, gradul de credibilitate, încredere în sine, farmec și onestitate, înainte că tu să fi comunicat ceva? Te-ai gândit vreodată că gesturile tale, postura, expresia chipului și contactul vizual ar putea să-ți fi sabotat deja mesajul? Știai că, de fiecare data când există discrepanțe între limbajul verbal și cel nonverbal, interlocutorii tăi cred ce văd, nu ce le spui? Autoarea iți arată, cum să folosești limbajul trupului în favoarea ta pentru a-ți spori charisma, a-ți dezvolta abilitatea de a negocia și a-ți educa inteligența non-verbală. Completând explicațiile cu ilustrații ce facilitează înțelegerea lor, cartea este un instrument prețios, cu atât mai util în lumea actuală, în care comunicarea virtuală este din ce în ce mai folosită. Limbajul trupului este o adevărată „armă secretă", pe care mulți lideri au învățat s-o utilizeze pentru a obține succesul. Acum poți și tu să beneficiezi de ea!   Dr. Carol Kinsey Goman este instructor de leadership, consultant în management și conducător de seminare pentru corporații, asociații și agenții americane de stat. Colaborează cu peste o sută de organizații, precum PepsiCo, Cisco, Hewlett-Packard și Biblioteca Congresului american. A publicat unsprezece cărți și peste trei sute de articole despre leadership, comunicare și limbajul trupului la locul de muncă. Este colaborator al Forbes.com și Illashington Post și a participat la numeroase emisiuni de televiziune la posturile CNN, ABC și NBC.

# Mastering Non-Verbal Communication: The Secret Language of Success

Are you aware that people evaluate you subconsciously within the first seven seconds of meeting them? Before a single word is exchanged, your credibility, confidence level, charm, and honesty are assessed based entirely on what they see.

The book *The Secret Language of Success* reveals how profoundly powerful body language truly is. It tackles the critical concept that when there is a discrepancy between your spoken words (verbal) and your physical cues (non-verbal), listeners will always believe what they *see*, not what you say. If you feel like your gestures, posture, or eye contact might be sabotaging your message during important conversations, this guide is for you.

***

### Understanding the Power of Body Language

This non-fiction deep dive into **non-verbal communication** acts as a powerful tool for anyone seeking professional growth. It moves beyond basic tips to provide actionable strategies on how to consciously and effectively use your physical presence in your favor.

The book teaches you how to:
*   **Boost Charisma:** Learn techniques to increase your magnetic appeal and connection with others.
*   **Negotiate Effectively:** Understand the subtle cues used by skilled negotiators and learn how to deploy them yourself to achieve better outcomes.
*   **Enhance Your Non-Verbal Intelligence:** Develop a deeper understanding of human behavior, making you a more insightful leader in any setting.

Whether you are navigating high-stakes meetings or trying to improve your everyday interactions, mastering the language of the body is presented as a true "secret weapon" used by top leaders worldwideâa skill now available for you to harness.

### Why This Book Is Essential Reading

In today's digital world, where communication often happens virtually, understanding and controlling non-verbal signals is more critical than ever. The author provides detailed explanations supported by illustrations, making complex topics easy to grasp. This book doesn't just explain *what* body language is; it shows you exactly *how* to use it for measurable success in your career and personal life.

### About the Author
**Dr. Carol Kinsey Goman** brings extensive expertise to this subject matter. She is a recognized leadership instructor, management consultant, and seminar leader who has worked with American corporations, associations, and state agencies, including PepsiCo, Cisco, Hewlett-Packard, and the Library of Congress. With over 11 books published and hundreds of articles on leadership and body language, Dr. Goman is also a contributor to Forbes.com and The Washington Post, and her insights have been featured on major networks like CNN, ABC, and NBC.

### Purchase Details
*   **Title:** The Secret Language of Success: How to Understand and Use Non-Verbal Communication
*   **Brand:** Litera
*   **Category:** Non-Fiction
*   **Price:** 39.99

[Click here to purchase your copy of *The Secret Language of Success* and start mastering the art of communication today.](https://event.2performant.com/events/click?ad_type=product_store&unique=23f76a2ac&aff_code=bf1d69700&campaign_unique=0a8a2c4d9)

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book only for professional settings?**
A: No. While it provides invaluable tools for leadership and negotiation, the principles of non-verbal communication apply to all aspects of lifeâfrom dating and family interactions to casual conversations with friends.

**Q: How quickly can I improve my body language skills?**
A: The book offers practical exercises designed to help you build awareness rapidly. Consistent practice is key, but even understanding the fundamentals will give you noticeable improvements in how others perceive you.

***

**Keywords:** non-verbal communication, body language, charisma, confidence building, leadership skills, successful negotiation, personal development, self-improvement, effective communication, public speaking
